title: Full Progress: CI Runners Shared Pool
hero: Manager for shared self-hosted GitHub Actions runners on your own machines: controller, node agent, web console, CLI and tray in one binary, crsp.
lede: v0.1.27 is live (RELEASE-67). RELEASE-68 (pool-add-agent fixes, flaky test) and RELEASE-69 (leaner CI, runner gaps, notifications) are in progress: about 15 cloud agents run, 13 PRs are open and most are green. RELEASE-68 is expected ~16:45 and RELEASE-69 ~17:15 Lisbon.
